status: Open direct-obligation decomposition and implementation-source review. No named assessment or completion package closes.
scope: KerML FeatureValue direct properties, three directly owned constraints and the typing/binding dependencies relevant to invocation defaults. Inherited OwningMembership/Relationship/Element obligations require their own linked review.
ownershipRequirements: One Feature may own at most one FeatureValue (FeatureValue class prose).
featureWithValue is the owning Feature; value is the owned Expression. FeatureValue ownership does not make the owning Feature the value Expression featuring type.
Boolean property defaults and reciprocal ownership need validation on abstract graphs as well as text-built models.

constraints.name: validateFeatureValueIsInitial
constraints.requirement: An initial FeatureValue requires its featureWithValue to be variable.
acceptancePartitions: Both isInitial values crossed with complete true/false/unknown effective isVariable; distinguish the FeatureValue property from its owning Feature property.
Kernel explicit variability and SysML derived variability, inherited/redefined features and occurrence contexts.
Missing or contradictory featureWithValue/value ownership, malformed Boolean fields and abstract graphs without source-value tables.
Canonical diagnostic identity and source location where text exists; abstract API verdict independent of textual syntax.

constraints.name: validateFeatureValueOverriding
constraints.requirement: Every feature in the complete transitive redefinition closure must have only default FeatureValues before a new valuation may override it.
acceptancePartitions: Direct and transitive redefinitions; default versus nondefault inherited valuation; no inherited valuation.
Diamond sharing, multiple redefined targets, cycles and unresolved endpoints; one known violation can refute, but an incomplete search cannot prove validity.
Owned default and owned concrete values both activate the rule. Selection of an effective default is a separate operation.
Explicit and positional/implied redefinition, aliases resolved by identity, prepared-library targets and abstract FeatureValues absent from syntax bookkeeping.
Canonical diagnostic identity and target source location, plus malformed ownership/Boolean fields and post-edit invalidation.
dependencies: FeatureValue default flag and membership identity
Source mapping distinct from abstract validation

constraints.name: checkFeatureValueBindingConnector
constraints.requirement: A nondefault valuation requires an owned BindingConnector joining the featureWithValue to the ordered value/result feature chain, with the appropriate featuring context.
sourceExpressions: not isDefault implies     featureWithValue.ownedMember->         selectByKind(BindingConnector)->exists(b |             b.relatedFeature->includes(featureWithValue) and             b.relatedFeature->exists(f |                  f.chainingFeature = Sequence{value, value.result}) and             if not isInitial then                  b.featuringType = featureWithValue.featuringType             else                  b.featuringType->exists(t |                     t.oclIsKindOf(Feature) and                     t.oclAsType(Feature).chainingFeature =                         Sequence{                             resolveGlobal('Base::things::that').                                 memberElement,                             resolveGlobal('Occurrences::Occurrence::startShot').                                 memberElement                         }                 )             endif)
acceptancePartitions: Default versus nondefault; bound versus initial; exact feature, expression and selected-result identities.
The chain must contain value then value.result; the raw value Expression endpoint alone is insufficient for this explicit OCL.
Noninitial featuring types equal the featureWithValue featuring types; initial context includes the chain Base::things::that then Occurrences::Occurrence::startShot.
Reciprocal owning membership, both connector ends and ReferenceSubsetting endpoints; required binary-link ancestry, end redefinitions and general connector obligations.
Missing/ambiguous library identities, inherited results, unavailable type/featuring projections, cycles, metadata, edits and atomic construction collision/retry.
Invocation default bindings remain a distinct obligation with the recorded prose/Table 11 formulation discrepancy; this rule does not itself apply when isDefault=true.

typingDependency.requirement: Only undirected features with no non-implied owned specialization require additional specialization to the value result. Directed or explicitly specialized declarations retain their independent static typing; value compatibility and binding validity remain separate.

sourceFindings: check/structural.rs has an initial-value diagnostic using a shared variability helper and explicit FeatureValue rows; complete abstract ownership, derived variability and mutation acceptance partitions remain unqualified.

check/values.rs has an overriding diagnostic using the textual values/default_values maps and Facts redefinition lookup. This is an implementation candidate, not evidence for all abstract FeatureValue and implied-redefinition cases.

membership_evidence::valuation validates unique reciprocal FeatureValue membership, Expression member and Boolean property shapes. effective_defaults shares identity-based inherited selection; neither helper is the complete named validation rule.

At the recorded baseline, type_relations::feature_requirements refused all owned FeatureValues. The linked production progress now qualifies the false-antecedent static-typing cases; true-antecedent inference remains open.
The current invocation default connector recipe retains provisional raw expression endpoints. This review does not qualify full value/result-chain or featuring semantics.
closure: Exact source/API behavior and positive, negative, abstract-model, dependency, mutation and replay evidence must be executed against matching source. A second review must challenge partitions before any complete rule claim.
